svg.title: AstralBeam AB logo for light backgrounds
svg.desc: Horizontal geometric A and open-left B initials in the light theme foreground and primary colors on a transparent square canvas.
svg.metadata: AstralBeam light AB logo construction: - Provenance: the accepted A and B paths from astralbeam-wordmark-light.svg are reused unchanged. - Reusable ids: #astralbeam-logo, #astralbeam-logo-a, and #astralbeam-logo-b. - Canvas: 270 x 270 around a centered 234 x 100 horizontal AB lockup. - Spacing: 18 units between A and B, matching the median gap between wordmark letters. - Layout: both initials share the same cap line and baseline; padding is 18 units horizontally and 85 vertically. - Shared weight: both letters retain the wordmark's nominal 14-unit stroke on a 100-unit cap height. - A uses round caps and joins. B retains its open-left bowls, square terminals, and mitered joins. - Palette source: apps/webapp/src/brand/colors.css .light. - Embedded sRGB paints match the semantic tokens so this standalone SVG has no runtime CSS dependency.
